intro.text: A Rosharan creature. Riding in Tvlakv's slave caravan, Kaladin is startled to spot a deep purple one.
A small to mid-sized Rosharan crustacean with a long, thick body carried on dozens of pairs of thin, spiny legs.

description.text: While riding in Tvlakv's slave caravan, Kaladin was startled to spot a deep purple legger.
Leggers raise and lower hairlike spines that sense how hard and from where the wind blows.
